title: The Local Ghost Theorem in the Très Ramifié Case
summary: Let $p\geq 11$ and let $\barρ$ be a très ramifié representation. For a primitive projective-augmented module of the corresponding type, we prove the très ramifié analogues of the local results of Liu-Truong-Xiao-Zhao and thereby establish the local ghost conjecture in this case. The main difference here is that the Iwahori dimension increases by one between consecutive relevant classical weights and may therefore be odd. Accordingly, the proof of the near-Steinberg results must treat both integral and half-integral centres.
